title: Amenemhat IV
summary: King listed in CFAH-7A Table 3 (Egypt Dynasty 12).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 12. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7A (Table 3, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 12"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start Co-Rex: 1543; Start Sole-rex: 1539; End Sole-rex: 1530; Death or Deposition: none). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1543; Start Sole-rex: 1539; End Sole-rex: 1530; Death or Deposition: none
